tagline: Brain-inspired differentiable PyTorch toolkit for neuromorphic and computational neuroscience research.
description: BTorch is our lab's flagship open-source Python framework, evolved from SpikingJelly and influenced by BrainState, for building, simulating, and training recurrent spiking neural networks and biologically grounded circuit models directly in native PyTorch.
purpose: BTorch provides a unified software substrate for our NeuroAI program, connecting sparse connectome-style architectures and heterogeneous neuron-synapse dynamics to scalable gradient-based and local learning.
capabilities: Recurrent spiking neural network modeling with heterogeneous cellular parameters and stateful neuron and synapse modules using explicit buffer-managed memory.
Support for sparse and connectome-style network topologies alongside integrated analysis tools for dynamical criticality and Lyapunov spectra.
Native PyTorch training integration including torch.compile compatibility, gradient checkpointing, truncated backpropagation through time, and ONNX export.
